comments.value: I got your code to compile by changing your event names so that they don't start with a number. Probably the same reason it doesn't work if you end variables with a number, which you seem to be aware of since you append _ to variables ending with a number. Silly bug but at least you can work around it for now.
Looks like you figured this out - the new graph will not let you start variable names with a number to keep this from happening.
